audit.runtime: .NET 8 Windows Desktop, built with the .NET SDK selected by global.json
audit.architecture: Single local desktop client with lightweight MVVM, application services, local JSON persistence, winget CLI integration, and WiX-based installer sources.
audit.delivery_model: Repository scripts build the app and generate a WiX Burn setup EXE with internal x86/x64 MSIs. No deploy or release workflow is versioned.
audit.maturity: Operationally buildable and test-covered for repository-owned code paths; live winget smoke validation, installer generation, major-upgrade validation, repair validation, uninstall validation, and install artifact checks are automated.
audit.risk_summary: Remaining risk is limited to release-process validation outside this repository, such as running the same installer lifecycle script against an official historical release artifact when one is available.

canonical_entrypoints.typecheck: Covered by C# compilation in scripts\build.ps1 and scripts\internal\build-gate.ps1.
